observed_association: A synthetic longitudinal packet reports that a proxy symptom score improves after a model-suggested change, but the durable outcome is unmeasured.
counterfactual_intervention: Replace the association-only claim with a pre-registered perturbation: change one modifiable variable at a defined time point and test whether downstream endpoints move in the expected direction.
expected_directional_change: Proxy score may improve first, but durable endpoint must improve later without worsening safety signals.
proxy_endpoint: Short-window symptom or model score change.
durable_target_endpoint: Sustained functional improvement measured after the defined lag window.

missingness.sampling_irregularity: Synthetic fixture assumes irregular observations across time.

revision_reason: Adds explicit counterfactual sensitivity before association-only observations can be promoted into discovery memory.
falsification_route: Reject promotion if perturbing the claimed intervention variable does not change the endpoint direction or if immutable variables were treated as actionable.
next_executable_action: Run the validator and then wire this gate into the discovery-memory promotion checklist.
